Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing respirator requirements for asbestos abatement projects.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to respirator requirements for asbestos abatementprojects; and adding a new section to chapter 49.17 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.17 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For the purposes of respirator requirements for asbestos abatementprojects, an employer must comply with the federal standardsestablished in 29 C.F.R. Part 1910, as enacted on the effective date ofthis section. To the extent rules adopted by the department areinconsistent with the federal standards applicable to respiratorrequirements for asbestos abatement projects as enacted on theeffective date of this section, and until the time rules consistentwith the federal standard are adopted, the federal standards govern andcontrol.
